Coram : M.R. SHAH*, C.T. RAVIKUMAR
Specific Relief Act, 1963 : s. 28 – Rescission of agreement to sell, the specific performance of which is decreed – On facts, agreement to sell the suit property between the late mother of the appellant and the respondent – Suit for specific performance by the respondent – and directed the respondent to deposit balance sale consideration, however, the respondent failed to pay the same – After 853 days the respondent filed an application u/s. 148 CPC and s. 28 of the Specific Relief Act for extension of time to deposit the balance amount – Trial court
Decision Date : 24-02-2023 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 1363/2023 | Disposal Nature : Appeal(s) allowed | Bench : 2 Judges
